# Athena OS
> Athena OS is open-source vision AI for operations teams. Show it a photo or a short video, ask a question in plain words, and get counts, marked areas and next steps. Self-hosted. Apache-2.0.

## Start here
- [Home](https://dominicmathew240.github.io/Athena-OS/): Public landing page (no backend, no sign-in)
- [Portfolio](https://dominic.strateticsxp.com/): Ts. Dominic Mathew, Co-Founder and CTO of Stratetics Experts
- [Inspec-Ther](https://inspec-ther.com/): AI-driven thermal inspection of solar PV assets

## What it does
- Ask a camera photo a question in plain words
- Ready-made checks: parking occupancy, store foot traffic, corrosion, surface defects, safety gear
- Built-in open Qwen vision model, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
- Optional path to label pictures and train a dedicated detector

## Athena Vision
In-house Segment and Detect models for assisted annotation: label one picture, then review AI drafts on the rest. Bounding boxes, masks, and export to COCO, YOLO or VOC. This is the vision stack behind Inspec-Ther.

## Related product
Inspec-Ther is the solar inspection product. Athena Vision (Segment and Detect) is the in-house vision stack behind it. This page is the open-source Athena OS toolkit, not the hosted Inspec-Ther app.

## Access
This site is a static page. There is no account, API or cloud service here. See the portfolio for the work and the products.
